Scope: Owned disposable Excel, complete native Options revision and exact restoration
Isolation: Inactive Windows desktop; reuse verified Q006 isolation infrastructure from PR #20 before native execution
Preconditions: No existing Excel or other VBE test host whose preferences could overlap
Frozen candidate and harness SHA-256, actual loaded MVID, exact owned PID/start/window desktop
Durable complete baseline receipt before any preference mutation
Original process handle retained before native work
Every planned native case has a bounded observation deadline and an explicit restoration oracle

Cases.Action: Read complete options in a bounded sequence without preference writes
Cases.Oracle: Equal complete OptionsVersion and structurally equal Tabs; retain exact differing paths on failure

Cases.Action: Select one exact observed alternate font using the immediately preceding complete revision
Cases.Oracle: Confirmed commit and closed dialog, independent exact readback, original font restored

Cases.Action: Read the size catalogue before and after the font change; retain native branch/count/selection evidence when available
Cases.Oracle: An exact observed alternate size can be changed and restored; an empty catalogue must refuse without mutation and prove dialog closure. Refusal does not qualify size mutation

Cases.Action: Change foreground, background and indicator through exact observed native choices
Cases.Oracle: Each explicit category/value is read back and restored with a fresh complete revision

Cases.Action: Change one observed palette in a different Code Colors category
Cases.Oracle: Requested category retained, exact value readback and full original palette restored; no repeated selection notification

Cases.Action: Toggle the exact native margin-indicator checkbox once
Cases.Oracle: Real On/Off transition followed by exact restoration; a redundant write is not accepted

Cases.Action: Attempt one write against a genuinely obsolete complete revision after a confirmed change
Cases.Oracle: Exact refusal, independently closed dialog, unchanged post-refusal complete state

Cases.Action: Restore positively committed entries in reverse order using fresh reads
Cases.Oracle: Full original OptionsVersion and all Tabs match the retained baseline, including catalogues and category palettes

Cases.Action: Close the disposable seed without saving and request Quit only after all native work is terminal
Cases.Oracle: Exit code 0 from the original handle and clean private desktop inventory; no forced termination

StopRules: Lost, pending, refused unexpectedly or incomplete native replies retain exact ownership and prevent further dispatch
Never repeat a native mutation, selection notification, restoration or cleanup after an uncertain outcome
A hash without complete recorded Tabs is insufficient restoration evidence
Historical failures are retained separately; a later pass does not establish their cause
